description.value: Humpty's Big Plate Diner is the Fort St. John franchise of a Western Canadian family restaurant chain founded in 1977 and best known for its all-day breakfast and 'Famous Pan Scrambler.' Located on Alaska Road North, the full-service diner offers breakfast, burgers, and comfort-food classics with cash and card payment. It is one of only a handful of Humpty's locations in British Columbia, making it a notable sit-down option for cyclists travelling the Alaska Highway corridor.

address.value: 11724 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, V1J 4H9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The corporate website confirms Humpty's has an active Fort St. John, BC franchise, listed explicitly under both the Locations and Menus pages, establishing the business is real and open. The homepage explicitly advertises takeout and delivery ('Humpty's has takeout and delivery! Order Now'), which is the only cyclist-relevant amenity confirmed by website text. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched pages, and the local branch phone number in OSM cannot be verified through the corporate website.
concerns: OSM website URL points to the corporate Humpty's site (humptys.com) rather than a location-specific page; the local branch phone number (+1-250-785-4755) cannot be verified through the corporate website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible full-service family restaurant confirmed active via the corporate website's locations listing; a useful meal stop for cyclists on the Alaska Highway corridor.
